what_happened: Both orphan prototypes compile clean against the live tree on first attempt (lake env lean exit 0 via the build guard, 2.37s and 1.75s), with every headline theorem's #print axioms showing only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (or [propext, Quot.sound]). scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh does cd "$(dirname $0)/.." at line 95, so a copy of it run from outside scripts/ silently resolves specs/evidence against the wrong root and reports FAIL (missing: ...) for every wired probe. Cost one wasted full gate run during the compile-verify measurement; fixed by placing the trial copy inside scripts/ instead.
